slides.title: Introduction to Convolutional Neural Networks
bullet_points: Biological inspiration from mammalian visual cortex
Spatial locality and translation invariance principles
Key contrast with traditional Multi-Layer Perceptrons
slides.code_snippet:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

# Standard 2D Convolution
conv = nn.Conv2d(
    in_channels=3,
    out_channels=16,
    kernel_size=3,
    stride=1,
    padding=1
)
slides.spoken_script: Welcome to today's module on Deep Learning. In this section, we explore Convolutional Neural Networks, or CNNs. Unlike standard feedforward neural networks that flatten image inputs, CNNs preserve spatial relationships across neighboring pixels using local receptive fields.

slides.title: Convolutional Filters & Feature Maps
bullet_points: Kernels slide across the input matrix using 2D dot products
Early layers detect edges, lines, and gradients
Deeper layers assemble semantic objects and complex patterns
slides.code_snippet:
# Compute spatial output dimension
# W_out = floor((W_in - K + 2*P) / S) + 1
slides.spoken_script: The core mathematical operation is the 2D cross-correlation filter. As kernels slide across the image, they extract hierarchical feature representations. Lower layers isolate basic edges, while deeper layers detect high-level semantic shapes.

slides.title: Pooling Layers and Downsampling
bullet_points: Max Pooling: extracts highest-intensity activation per region
Average Pooling: calculates regional spatial mean
Reduces computational parameters and controls overfitting
slides.spoken_script: Following convolutional feature extraction, pooling layers progressively reduce the spatial dimensions of the representation. Max pooling preserves the most dominant features while substantially decreasing compute requirements.

slides.title: Summary & Practical Recommendations
bullet_points: CNN architectures dominate computer vision tasks
Residual connections enable training of hundreds of layers
Next session: Transfer Learning with ResNet and Vision Transformers
slides.spoken_script: To summarize, Convolutional Neural Networks revolutionized computer vision by drastically reducing parameter counts through weight sharing. In our upcoming session, we will examine Residual Networks and modern Vision Transformers. Thank you.
